claims.statement: The Zoom token endpoint issues a Bearer access token for the account_credentials grant used by Server-to-Server OAuth apps; it lives one hour (3600 seconds), has no refresh token, and stops working when the app is deactivated.

sources.supports: Use the account_credentials grant type to generate an access token.
The token's time to live is one hour (3600 seconds).

claims.statement: The API-usage page, as read on this date, still refers to JWT apps as an app kind separate from OAuth apps whose requests need no scopes; it does not describe the JWT-app credential, its format or its retirement.

sources.supports: You do not need scopes for JWT apps.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.

openQuestions.question: Not researched beyond existence: prefix, alphabet, length and any checksum are not stated on the pages read, and no value shape may be inferred from the examples (docs examples are placeholders or illustrative).
Documentation examples show the access_token value as the placeholder <JWT_TOKEN> but the pages read do not state that issued tokens are JWTs or give any structure; shape stays unresolved.

Historical JWT-app credentials (API key/secret and the JWT signed from them) are not documented on the pages read beyond a passing mention; whether and when they were retired needs a pinned historical source before any historical claim.
